profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin with 6+ years of experience developing mission-critical software supporting the U.S. Department of Defense.
I earned my Bachelor's degree in Computer Science with a concentration in Human-Centered Computing from Colorado State University. Throughout my career, I've worked on complex command and control systems, building software that emphasizes reliability, scalability, and collaboration across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
My experience spans Java, C#, C++, Python, and modern software development practices. I enjoy solving challenging technical problems, learning new technologies, and developing software that supports critical missions.
Core skills include Java, C#, C++, Python, Object-Oriented Programming, Agile Development, Software Design, System Integration, and Team Collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer Sr
positions.description:
Develop and maintain Java-based software supporting the Command and Control, Battle Management, and Communications (C2BMC) program.
Design and enhance messaging services to enable secure, reliable communication across distributed systems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop, test, integrate, and deploy high-quality software solutions.
Troubleshoot complex issues and implement enhancements using Agile software development practices.
